notes.title: METAL SLUG TACTICS: PATCH 1.0.2
notes.content:
Greetings, Peregrine Falcons!
We’ve just deployed a fresh patch for Metal Slug Tactics on Steam! This update is all about bug fixes, balancing tweaks, performance boosts, and quality-of-life enhancements to make your tactical battles smoother and more exciting than ever.
Here’s what’s included in this update:
[list]

[h3][b]Balancing & Feature[/b][/h3]
[*] Reworked Clark’s Argentine Backbreaker to differentiate it from Stargazer. Now Clark
rushes towards the enemy before hurling them.
[*] Clark’s Argentine Backbreaker costs -1 ADR (all 3 levels)
[*] You can now give up your current run at any time. This triggers the Defeat screen,
grants currency rewards, and then takes you back to the Character Selection screen.
[*] Rebind for Camera Move (WASD) added
[*] Rebind for cursor superposition cycling added. Default keys: page up/page down
[*] Protect Miners is now easier for the first 3 difficulties, lowered the count of required miners to be kept alive to complete the mission
[*] Trevor’s Shinobi I & II now cost +1 ADR
[*] Trevor’s Shinobi III now doesn’t grant a bonus action if the target dies
[*] Trevor’s Flying Blade now doesn’t grant a bonus action if the target dies (all 3 levels)
[*] Trevor’s Flying Blade now has a reduced launch range, reduced damage for level 3, and increased ADR cost for level 1


[h3][b]Feedback & Interface[/b][/h3]
[*] The Desynchronized feedback on bosses is now triggered after all sync attacks have
been performed
[*] Increased screen size for Special Action upgrade popups
[*] Improved AOE now display in popups
[*] Enemies’ level is now displayed in their popup
[*] Profiles do not use display names anymore, nor they require a keyboard for
creation
[*] The 3 available profile slots are displayed explicitly


[h3][b]Bug Fixes & Performance Optimizations[/b][/h3]
[*] Lightning Idol now deals damage on high ground
[*] Explosive props destroyed in a Sync attack now correctly apply their damage
[*] Players can now sync on targets hit by an explosive prop
[*] Syncs, including destructible crates, are now properly previewed
[*] The Convoy is not hurt by Geyers
[*] The Convoy does no longer open Sarcophagi
[*] Fixed the “Spy” achievement
[*] When moving an enemy with a Special Action in a mine’s AOE, the mine is now only
triggered if the enemy is not killed by the action, or if another enemy is in the AOE
[*] Enemy Chaser now correctly predicts sync attacks
[*] Fixed Special Actions that could not hit Dragon Nosuke : Dynamite Punch, Enemy
Chaser, Galactica Phantom
[*] Fixed pathfinding bug after room transitions in Dragon Nosuke’s mission
[*] The game now keeps backups for save files if the game/computer crashes during the
save process
[*] Sync attacks are no longer previewed for units killed by the original attack
[*] Spotlight II & III AOEs should now correctly display in popups
[*] Fixed an issue for which delayed Hits for the Rebel Tower were sometimes not correctly restored on reload or reset turn
[*] Rewards drawn in the Outpost are now saved and won’t change on reload
[*] Incubator animations now play correctly
[*] Special Actions cannot break anymore when opening the Pause Menu during
preview
[*] The destroyed Rebel Tower now stays on screen
[*] The camera now starts at the correct position when reloading the Dragon Nosuke mission
[*] The “War Machines” achievement now correctly triggers when defeating Dragon Nosuke
[*] Target statuses don’t count for the “A Sister” achievement
[*] Combustion triggers if a sync kills an enemy
[*] Units in Slugs are not killed during room transitions
[*] Correctly initialize reinforcements when selecting another difficulty
[*] Destroy idols objective counter
[*] Hide the enter slug UI “IN” feedback after destruction
[*] Cannot one-shot Abul Abbas and Allen O’Neil by invoking slugs on their position
[*] Don't play idle for empty slugs on continue
[*] Lingering character visual when resetting a turn with a character inside a slug
[*] Alice is now correctly restored on continue
[*] Added bleeding effect description
[*] Fixed all occurrences of several music tracks playing at the same time
[*] Improved performance when there are Delayed Hits
[*] Improved performance for Jupiter King
[*] Improved performance when playing with a controller
[*] Improved performance when displaying units range
[*] Improved general performances in mission
[h3][b]Sounds[/b][/h3]
[*] Polish, resync, and added missing SFX for
○ Leona's Skills and her afterimages (attack type/hits)
○ Nadia's Skills
○ Trevor's Skills
○ Clark's Skills
○ Ralf’s Skills
[*] Enhanced "no damage" feedback
[*] Mummy players now no longer trigger Flamethrower or grenade sound upon weapon
selection
[*] Fixed announcer randomly not saying "you're great" on level up
[/list]

notes.title: Metal Slug Tactics review: the crunchy arcade run 'n' gun pauses to have a tactical think
notes.content:
I am a very casual enjoyer of Metal Slug games. I've never actually paid for one of these side-scrolling shoot 'em ups, except for all the countless coins I happily pumped into arcade machines as a child. To this day, if I see a rare glittering cabinet running one of these crunchy shmups, I will go ham for twenty or thirty minutes, and walk away satisfied that I have seen a lot of very good pixels. These games, I am convinced, were never really designed to be completed, but to be played exactly like this, as a coin-gobbling invitation to become a bandana-wearing sisyphus, a tiny Rambo pushing a bouncy, juddering tank up a hill occupied by cartoon nazis. You die a bunch and say: "ah, that was good."

So what happens when you rearrange the molecules of this run and/or gun 'em up into an isometric turn-based strategy game? You get Metal Slug Tactics, an off-kilter nod to Into The Breach and other grid-based turn-takers, but secretly housing the aggressive notions of an unhinged pyromaniac. You still die a lot. And you still walk away feeling fairly happy about it.

notes.title: METAL SLUG TACTICS: KNOWN ISSUES
notes.content:
Greetings Squad,

First and foremost, the entire team would like to [b]sincerely thank you for playing METAL SLUG TACTICS[/b]. We are extremely grateful for your engagement and support during this launch.

We are aware of a few issues that may have impacted your gameplay experience. Our team is already on the case, working diligently to smooth out these wrinkles and ensure an even better tactical experience. 

The development team will dedicate the next few weeks to [b]fixing the following known issues[/b]:

[list]
[*] Grenade-type weapons sometimes can’t hit enemies standing on different elevations despite being in range
[*] Kills caused by cranes, barrel explosions, metal slugs, or any non-character damage) do not count towards “kill X enemies” mission objectives.
[*] When playing Trevor and previewing an attack with his secondary weapon Laser, using the Turn Reset feature will cause a softlock.
[u][i]Workaround:[/i][/u] back out of attack previews before using a Turn Reset.
[*] Profile creation is not currently possible while using a gamepad. Using the mouse to complete profile creation is enough to play the rest of the game with a controller.
[*] If you manage to reach the final biome “City” without unlocking a Strategic Asset during your run, some missions may not offer primary arsenal rewards.
[*] Characters killed in unusual conditions (boss phase transitions, while mummified, in a vehicle…) might reappear with missing arms. The issue is purely visual : the character still counts as dead for all experience and gameplay purposes.
[*] The game does not pause on loss of focus. Sound, and animations will continue when tabbed out
[*] The Rebind keys option is currently not implemented
[*] Controller rumble has not yet been implemented
[*] [spoiler] Dragon Nosuke boss [/spoiler] sometimes becomes untargetable after room transition: When Nosuke “breaks the ground” and changes the room, the boss sometimes spawns out of reach.
[i][u]Workaround:[/u][/i] Using Turn Reset will fix the issue. Quitting the game and reloading the fight might also work.
[*] There is no currently no tutorial explaining how to free a prisoner: This does not cost an action. To free a prisoner, simply move a character near a prisoner and interact with them. Note that if the character begins their turn near a prisoner, interacting with the prisoner will still consume the movement as if using an action to interact with a lever.
[/list]


If you encounter any other issues during your gameplay and require support, please contact us through the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1590760/discussions/1/]dedicated Steam Forum[/url] or our [url=https://discord.gg/NAMfubQXvt]Official Discord[/url]. Until now, the most successful was probably R-Type Tactics (originally for the humble PSP, and now currently being remade), but I think the crown might have to go to Metal Slug Tactics... Read more.

notes.title: Metal Slug Tactics (PC) Review
notes.content:
Despite being genuinely interested in Metal Slug Tactics, I never really played a lot of the main series games. That’s not to say I didn’t like Metal Slug, because I honestly always have, but my opportunities to go to good arcades as a kid were limited and I just never seemed to get chances to play it. As I got a bit older and Metal Slug got re-released on multiple consoles, I finally got a proper chance to experience this true classic in the Shoot ‘Em Up genre.

Metal Slug Tactics felt to me like both a surprise and a logical spin-off for the franchise. On the one hand, it seems odd that a game so defined by its frenetic energy would branch off into a genre that’s all about taking your time and planning carefully. On the other hand, games like Advance Wars and Wargroove have proven—both in gameplay and aesthetic—that you can apply faster, more arcade sensibilities to Turn-Based Strategy games.

I didn’t really know what to expect with Metal Slug Tactics, and I can... Read more

notes.title: Metal Slug Tactics roguishly reinvents turn-based run-and-gun
notes.content: I’ve lost way too much time to the Metal Slug series over the years, that most ubiquitous of Neo Geo arcade shooters. Classic Contra-adjacent run-and-gun shooters; loud, dumb and gorgeously animated. So how on earth does that translate to a turn-based tactics game? After playing a few rounds of the surprisingly beefy demo, the answer is ‘impressively well’, a few rough edges aside... Read more.

notes.title: FREE DEMO AVAILABLE NOW!
notes.content:
Greetings squad,

The free Metal Slug Tactics demo is live until June 17, courtesy of Steam Next Fest. Get your first tactical briefing with our Gameplay Introduction Trailer.

[previewyoutube=ljVNq3x2g_4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1][b]About the demo[/b][/h1]

The Metal Slug Tactics demo is a [b]Work In Progress[/b]. As a result, you may encounter [b]a few known issues[/b] that the development team is already investigating and working on. 

-----

[b][h2]Steam Next Fest Demo - Known Issues[/h2][/b]

[h3][b]General[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] No controller support in this demo, it will be available for release.
[*] No rebinding is possible in this demo, it will be available for release.
[*] Some options reset when you return to the Main Menu (e.g. tooltip delays or screen edge panning)
[*] Can't zoom in/out, it will be available for release.
[*] Minor graphical problems when the game is played in lower graphics quality: strategic map and Boss Art are not centered.
[*] A small graphic artifact at the bottom of the screen that looks like a gray square may appear at times.
[*] Some UI elements are in the foreground and hide certain menus if they are not closed beforehand: typically, mission tooltips are displayed above the Pause menu or options.
[/list]

[h3][b]Crash & Blockers[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Rare: crash when loading Boss level.
[*] Rare: sometimes validate buttons do not work.
[list]
[*] [u][b]Workaround:[/b][/u] reboot the game and click Continue.
[/list]
[/list]

[h3][b]Tutorial[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] When opening the Pause menu or performing unscripted actions (e.g. pressing a Reset Turn when the game asks for something else), crashes and soft locks may occur.
[list]
[*] [u][b]Workaround:[/b][/u] Avoid straying from tutorial instructions. If you encounter a soft Lock/crash, going back to the Main Menu and starting a new game will restart the tutorial from the beginning.
[/list]
[*] Some tutorial panels may hide the pause menu (you can close these panels).
[*] Tutorial restarts if you return to Main Menu in the middle of it/after finishing it the first time.
[/list]

[h3][b]Soldier Select - Barracks - Armory[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] If you open the description of an Asset in the Armory and start a run, the description will appear on the screen throughout the run. 
[list]
[*] [u][b]Workaround:[/b][/u] Return Soldier Select when restarting a game, open Armory, Select an Asset, then go to a weapon profile.
[/list]
[*] If you buy an item in the Barracks/Armory and return to the Main Menu, the purchase is canceled and the money is returned to the player. The game saves only after restarting a run.
[/list]

[h3][b]In-Game[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] It is possible to start a run without any unit selected. 
[*] [u][b]Workaround:[/b][/u] Return to the main menu and relaunch a run with "Start a new game".
[*] It is currently impossible to reread explanatory texts once closed, a codex is planned for release.
[*] The objective counter is not reset by pressing "Reset Turn".
[*] Victory/defeat screen: The exit button is sometimes inactive/not clickable. 
[*] [u][b]Workaround:[/b][/u] Restart the game to continue.
[*] Switches and cranes still have their "Use" UI then even after use (when they are no longer usable).
[*] The "SAVE" IU for prisoners remains displayed after releasing them.
[*] Layering and transparency issues at times affect the visibility of characters and enemies.
[*] The same applies to preview movements, especially when there are elevation changes or jumps.
[*] Loss of FPS when using Grenade Juggle - especially on the second attack.
[*] Trampolines remain displayed after a reset but are not functional.
[*] Sometimes targets don't have the target over their heads to recognize them.
[list]
[*] [u][b]Workaround:[/b][/u] Move mouse over Objective to highlight targets
[/list]
[*] Sync preview missing when targeting an enemy on a wooden box. Sync will still take place normally.
[*] On some dual-target attacks, pressing repeatedly on the same target increments an infinite number of damage but never performs the attack. 
[list]
[*] [u][b]Workaround:[/b][/u] cancel the attack and restart by selecting 2 different targets
[/list]
[/list]

[h3][b]Boss fight[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Some performance issues may occur after a few turns.
[/list]

notes.title: Metal Slug Tactics' latest gameplay trailer teases some towering boss battles
notes.content:
Metal Slug Tactics adding a third-dimension looks to have been an excellent idea. As we saw during E3, the traditionally 2D platformer has spawned an isometric strategy game. Aesthetically, it’s lost nothing in translation. The pixelly characters look lovely in any dimension, and the levels are delightfully detailed dioramas filled with fun little battles. Metal Slug also had giant bosses to cap off levels, and though there's a new perspective in play, the latest gameplay trailer for Metal Slug Tactics shows the bosses are as meaty as before.

notes.title: METAL SLUG TACTICS - REVEAL TRAILER
notes.content:
Greetings soldiers,

Today, a new mission is upon us and it is proposed to you by [b]Leikir Studio[/b] and [b]Dotemu[/b], who have teamed up to reveal [b]Metal Slug Tactics[/b]. Will you accept it?

[previewyoutube=DqF0KLsaf6U;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]MISSION START[/b]

[b]METAL SLUG[/b] is back for a fresh, but just as explosive, experience with Metal Slug Tactics - a dynamic tactical RPG with roguelike elements - that stays true to the original series' timeless spirit and aesthetic, especially with its gorgeous pixel art graphics!

In this brand new game, the legendary soldiers of the [b]Peregrine Falcon Squad[/b] such as [b]Marco, Eri, Fio and Tarma[/b] are finally reunited to face the most iconic enemies and bosses of the classic series! Pick your perfect team and use your best strategy, as the unpredictable lies in every aspect of the battlefield! 

Indeed, Metal Slug Tactics features a challenging (yet exuberant) gameplay, in which each battle is unique! Also, thanks to the roguelite elements, the game replayability is high, and the “die and retry” aspect of the classic series remains intact.

Soldiers, we know that this brand new mission is different from the old ones, but we hope you'll enjoy it just as much! In the meantime, stay tuned for more intel and don't forget to throw a grenade at the wishlist button right there:
